## What landed

- **`genre.py`** — `DocumentGenre.STATUTORY_REPORT`, deliberately
  absent from the classifier's marker table: statutory filings
  share vocabulary with policy and deployment documents, so the
  classifier never guesses the genre; a reviewed adapter declares
  it as the fallback for captures whose own text classifies to no
  genre (a text-derived genre always stands — the pathways rule).
- **`government_mandated_disclosure.py`** (+578) — the
  generalization beyond municipal CCOPS (I8 NEW-8):
  `technology_map()`/`technology_slugs()`/`_norm_literal()`/
  `_assert_declared_slug()`/`TechnologySlugNotDeclared` — the
  literal→PKG-07-slug map whose values must be ACTIVE
  `ontology/vocab/technology.yaml` members; `_declared_genre()` —
  the reviewed fallback applied only on UNKNOWN; `_entry_literal`/
  `_index_entries`/`_extract_statutory_entries` — page-carried
  `agency` rows emit `inventory_entry` `approval_status`
  assertions (a typed `technology` claim only where the row's own
  literal maps; a declared slug is never emitted on faith —
  SIG-ONTO-021), `location` rows emit verbatim
  `deployment_location` `disclosure_use` claims keyed to the
  preceding agency heading and only where the filing reports use
  (`doc.reports_actual_use`), kept as the published string —
  never geocoded (SIG-GEO-003); `field_patterns`/`use_fields`
  (use predicates only; `value = true` pinning keeps the literal
  as `raw_value`); `agency_anchor_pattern`/`agency_field_pattern`
  (per-filing agency from the resolved link's anchor or the
  form's own field — never the publisher name); `scope_terms`
  (the surveillance-relevance admission screen for the broad
  deposit catalogues); `document_entries` (the entries mechanism
  over a filing's own bytes — VT DPS); `reports_use`/
  `reports_use_pattern` (the filing's own use statement);
  plaintext-extract document handling (`text_layer =
  "plaintext_extract"` for committed extracts of large upstream
  filings); statutory reporting-period derivation (`UPDATED:`,
  `Date:`, filename fragments, covered years); Part VIII
  suppressions recorded on the artifact row, never silently
  dropped.
- **`cli.py`** — `technology_map_violations()` wired into
  `sig-connectors validate`: every `[technology_map]` value and
  adapter-declared slug must be an active ontology member; entry
  `kind` values and `use_fields` predicates must be members of
  their closed sets — a broken declaration fails closed at the
  gate, never at emit.
- **Vocab** (`government_mandated_disclosure_vocab.toml`,
  `vocab_version 2026.10.12` with the migration note): ten
  `[sources]` keys → the ten I8 §5.5 registry ids;
  `statutory_report` joins `[genre_claim_types]`
  (`ordinance`, `inventory_entry`, `disclosure`,
  `disclosure_use`; no `compliance_finding`); the 60-literal
  `[technology_map]`; the ten reviewed `[adapters.<publisher>]`
  specs (entries, field_patterns, use_fields, reports_use,
  document_genre, technology_mapped, default_technology,
  agency_anchor_pattern, technology_anchor/field patterns,
  scope_terms, doc_url_contains/doc_suffixes). The `[aggregate]`
  schema gate and forbidden-column/token guards are untouched
  and bind the new rows.
